style.variety: natural, fluent standard Persian, written in Persian script (right to left); keep Latin-script names, terms and URLs as-is inline

text.شما: Address the reader formally with «شما» (plural/polite 'you') everywhere, in tutorials and technical pages alike.

style.loanwords_text: Use the Persian word where the terminology list gives one; common crypto loanwords Persian readers use (توکن, کامیونیتی, گرنت, بلاک‌چین) are written in Persian script. The terminology list below wins over this rule.
writing_rules: Use the half-space (ZWNJ, نیم‌فاصله) in compounds and before suffixes: کیف‌پول‌ها, استخراج‌کننده, سخت‌افزاری.
